name: io.github.ezumba/vanguard-memory-node
description: Local deterministic BM25 memory for AI agents via MCP. Offline-first, SHA-256 shards, stdio.

environmentVariables.name: EXERGYNET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional ExergyNet Portal API key (sk-exergy-...) for vmn_sync_vault and AUTO_SYNC_VAULT.

environmentVariables.name: EXERGYNET_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Optional vault sync target: mainnet or testnet (default testnet).

environmentVariables.name: EXERGYNET_VAULT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional custom vault base URL overriding EXERGYNET_NETWORK.

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_SYNC_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to auto-sync vmn_ingest shards to ExergyNet vault.
